description: Canonical Product Requirements Document (PRD v4.0.0) modular specifications

documents.title: PRD Module 00: Overview, System Context & Platform Requirements
documents.summary: Defines the problem statement, business goals, target audience (B2G/B2B), Greenfield Hub-and-Spoke architecture, core user journeys, UI/UX accessibility standards, and functional/non-functional requirements for the PT Daya Berkah Sentosa Nusantara (`dayaberkah.id`) centralized platform.

documents.title: PRD Module 01: Universal RFQ Cart Schema, Data Models & Telemetry
documents.summary: Specifies the composite multi-item cart data model, Sanity CMS content schemas, transactional database tables (`rfq_submissions` & `rfq_line_items`), GA4 telemetry instrumentation, and formal acceptance test cases.

documents.title: PRD Module 02: Authentication, Access Control & Client Portal Model
documents.summary: Defines the unified Auth.js v5 authentication architecture across the catch-all route `/api/auth/[...nextauth]`, distinguishing internal Google OAuth (admin/viewer) from client Credentials access, along with row-level data isolation via `trackingScopeIds`.

documents.title: PRD Module 03: API Contracts, Response Envelopes & Error Policies
documents.summary: Mandates the standard `{ success, data, error, meta }` response envelope for all REST API endpoints, specifies the `POST /api/rfq` request/response contract, and establishes integration error policies.

documents.title: PRD Module 04: Environment Configuration, SEO Engine & Resilience
documents.summary: Defines runtime environment variables, Cloudflare Pages Wrangler secrets, feature flags, native Greenfield SEO architecture, notification pipelines, and emergency rollback procedures.

documents.title: PRD Module 05: Resolved Architectural Decisions Log
documents.summary: Authoritative historical log of all key architectural and product decisions (OQ-1 through OQ-6, plus Greenfield SEO Strategy) locked for the PT Daya Berkah Sentosa Nusantara platform baseline.
